summary.name: Deep Angel
summary.one_liner: The page is a Northwestern University research experiment asking visitors to pick which of two explanations they prefer for why a short social-media text seems human-written or AI-generated; it does not describe the Deep Angel object-removal tool.
use_cases: take part in an ai explanation preference study
research on how people judge ai-written social media posts
summary.what_it_does: ["The page presents a research experiment from Northwestern University's Computer Science department. Participants read short social-media texts, each written by a person or generated by AI, and see two explanations of why the text seems human or AI. The task is to choose the explanation that is clearer, more convincing, or more useful. The page states there is no right or wrong answer and choices are not scored. Participation is voluntary and limited to adults 18 or older. The page does not describe the Deep Angel object-removal tool that the directory listing associates with this URL."]
notable: Academic study run by Northwestern University Computer Science department
Choices are anonymous and not scored
Open to participants aged 18 or older
caveats: Page content does not match the directory listing: it is a research survey, not the Deep Angel image object-removal tool
Page does not state any object-removal features, platforms or pricing for Deep Angel
